newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd shares down after profit fall.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd shares down after profit fall.

text.p: Shares in Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV fell more than four percent in early trading after the group announced a 54 percent slide in net profit for 1996.
The shares were trading at 54.40 guilders at 0905 GMT, down 2.60 from the previous close.
One Amsterdam dealer said the shares fell on low volumes and despite some neutral to positive comments, especially from London brokers.
"Nevertheless the shares went down," he said, adding that it may be because the company was unsure about the prospects for the current year.
He also noted that some investment houses had been building up hopes for Nedlloyd's results in recent months.
Nedlloyd earlier announced a net profit of 49 million guilders for 1996, down from 106 million in 1995.
